name: herdr-navigator
description: Switches the VS Code workspace folder to the working directory of the focused herdr pane.

herdrNavigator.socketPath.description: herdr socket marker path. Empty uses the HERDR_SOCKET_PATH environment variable, else %APPDATA%\herdr\herdr.sock (a named pipe) on Windows, or ~/.config/herdr/herdr.sock on Linux and macOS.

herdrNavigator.cwdSource.description: Which pane directory to follow. auto uses the foreground process directory when known, else the pane directory.

enumDescriptions: Open the followed directory as the window's single folder. Reloads the window on every switch, which closes integrated terminals.
Keep the window and add the followed directory to a multi-root workspace next to an extension-owned empty anchor folder. No reloads.
herdrNavigator.followMode.description: How the window follows the focused herdr pane.

herdrNavigator.followGitRoot.description: Follow the Git repository root that contains the focused pane's directory instead of the exact directory.

herdrNavigator.debounceMs.description: Milliseconds to coalesce bursts of herdr focus events.

herdrNavigator.cwdPollMs.description: Milliseconds between checks for a directory change (cd) in the focused herdr pane. Values from 1 to 249 are raised to 250; 0 disables the check.

herdrNavigator.liveCwdProbe.description: Resolve the live directory of the focused herdr pane from its shell process: Linux /proc, macOS lsof, Windows Git Bash via its MSYS runtime.

herdrNavigator.autoLaunch.description: Relaunch herdr in an editor-area terminal when VS Code restores a navigator window in which herdr was running.

herdrNavigator.gitBashPath.description: Windows only: path to Git for Windows' usr\bin\bash.exe for the live cwd probe. Leave empty to auto-detect.
